policy_denials.detail: head -20 CHANGELOG.md; tail -30 docs/decisions.md; ls crates/athena-cli/tests | head -30; grep -n "steward" crates/athena-cli/tests/steward.rs | head -30
tail -n 25 docs/decisions.md; grep -c "" docs/decisions.md; grep -n "^## D" docs/decisions.md | tail -n 2

printf '
## D169 · The steward steps back and decides itself; the owner is asked only for an environment change or a token

- **Case:** The owner said the steward should do the step back and that decisions are unwelcome unless Athena needs an environment change or a token.
- **Decision:** `STEWARD_PROMPT` and the steward brief text now tell the steward to look across repeated failures and blind spots for the root cause, to decide the fix and write a request, and to write an owner brief only for an environment change or a token or credential. The role is version 3. The rule is prose-only: no code refuses a brief on another item. Cadence and highest rung are unchanged.
- **Alternatives:** Refuse briefs for other items in code: adds a refusal rule, out of scope here.
- **Tradeoff:** The model may still write a brief for another item; nothing stops it.
- **Reversal cost:** Low. Prompt text, one version number and tests.
- **Provenance:** Read: `roles.rs`, `steward.rs`, `roles-and-ladder.md`. Measured: the unit tests. Not measured: how the model behaves under the new prompt.
' >> docs/decisions.md; cargo test -p athena-data -p athena-core -p athena-cli 2>&1 | grep -E "^test result|FAILED|failed|panicked|error" | head -30
cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-data -p athena-core -p athena-cli 2>&1 | grep -E "^test result|FAILED|failed|panicked|^error" | head -30
cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-data -p athena-core -p athena-cli 2>&1 | tail -n 40
cargo test -q -p athena-data -p athena-core -p athena-cli -p xtask 2>&1 | rg "test result|FAILED|panicked|^error|failed"
cargo test -q -p athena-data -p athena-core -p athena-cli -p xtask 2>&1; echo EXIT $?
